evidence.reason: At the anchored line, `_declared_dropin_error` materializes and sorts every child of the declared drop-in directory before comparing it to the exact declared set. A directory with many entries therefore incurs unbounded allocation and sorting before the existing scan bound is applied, so the bound is not enforced on this path. Iterating with a cap/early exit avoids the resource-exhaustion path without changing the exact-set validation result.
